description: Shrinks a Playwright trace zip file by deleting screenshots outside the critical failure window (t_fail - 5s to t_fail + 1s). Returns original vs trimmed size and path to the new archive (.trimmed.zip).

divergence_only.description: If true, removes screenshots outside the critical failure window. If false, leaves them intact.

trace_path.description: Absolute path to trace.zip, or a URL (https://) to download it from

name: trim_trace_archive
